sloka: सुमहत्यपराधे ऽपि दूतस्यातुलविक्रम ।विरूपकरणं दृष्टं न वधो ऽस्तीति शास्त्रतः ।। ५.५८.१४८ ।।।।
transliteration: sumahatyaparādhe 'pi dūtasyātulavikrama ।virūpakaraṇaṁ dṛṣṭaṁ na vadho 'stīti śāstrataḥ ।। 5.58.148 ।।।।

translations.english: 'O Ravana of immeasurable courage even if the emissary has done any kind of harm he may be mutilated but not murdered. Nowhere do the sastras allow killing (of an ambassador).
